purpose: Requirement-by-requirement audit for the active patent-facing MyAgent vs MACT experiment goal.

runtime_recheck.interpretation: Fresh Qwen3-32B runs are not reliable under the current user constraint to use only GPUs 6,7.

requirements.requirement: Qwen3-32B full200 anchor evidence must show MyAgent exceeds MACT on WTQ, TabFact, and CRT, with lower token usage.
Mechanism evidence must support the patent concept of selective risk collaboration / persuasion-back instead of sample hardcoding.
requirements.gap: Fine-grained verifier-override/evidence-retention ablation remains optional unless fresh WTQ validation reveals unclear causality.

requirements.requirement: WTQ new-seed risk exposed by P4b must be closed with fresh Qwen validation before claiming stable all-dataset superiority.
requirements.known_result: P4b overall accepted by existing paired gate, but WTQ is MyAgent 37/50 vs MACT 43/50.

requirements.requirement: Multi-seed stability evidence must show the effect is not tied to one frozen full200 or one P4b seed.
Multi-model gate evidence must test whether the mechanism has model externality without running every model full200.
requirements.known_result: Qwen3-14B-AWQ, Qwen2.5-14B-AWQ, and Qwen2.5-3B were no-go under historical Gate-50 summaries.
requirements.gap: At least one additional viable local model or external API candidate still needs Gate-10 -> Gate-50 -> Gate-150 -> paired-200 evidence.

requirements.requirement: Expert/patent package and Chinese patent disclosure draft must exist and point to auditable evidence.
requirements.gap: Final claims and formal experiment section should be updated after R3/R4/R5 fresh evidence.

requirements.requirement: All process/result context must be recorded in the single PRD and MACT artifacts, then pushed to GitHub.

current_next_actions: After GPU 6,7 are clean and 8000/8001 endpoints are healthy, run WTQ targeted fresh affected slice.
If the affected slice passes, run P4b WTQ after-fix full50 and paired comparison.
Run E3 Seed-C/Seed-D current-only Gate-50, then run paired MACT only for seeds that pass current-only gate.
When a viable new model/API candidate appears, run the prepared gate funnel rather than full200 immediately.
reason_not_complete: Fresh WTQ closure, multi-seed execution, and at least one viable multi-model gate result remain missing.
